"};

</script>
<script>
/* Standalone pixel-layer renderer: no network, no live-agent dependencies. */
(function(global){
  'use strict';
  function canvas(w,h){const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;return c;}
  function image(url){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const i=new Image();i.onload=()=>resolve(i);i.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('PNG không đọc được'));i.src=url;});}
  function inPolygon(x,y,p){let hit=false;for(let i=0,j=p.length-1;i<p.length;j=i++){const [a,b]=p[i],[c,d]=p[j];if((b>y)!==(d>y)&&x<(c-a)*(y-b)/(d-b)+a)hit=!hit;}return hit;}
  const numeric={x:[-20000,20000],y:[-20000,20000],z:[-10000,10000],scaleX:[.01,100],scaleY:[.01,100],rotation:[-36000,36000],opacity:[0,1],tintMix:[0,1]};
  function validateLayer(l){
    if(!l||typeof l.id!=='string'||!l.id||l.id.length>160)throw Error('ID lớp không hợp lệ');
    if(typeof l.name!=='string')throw Error('Thiếu tên lớp');
    if(!l.source||![l.source.x,l.source.y,l.source.w,l.source.h].every(Number.isInteger)||l.source.w<1||l.source.h<1||l.source.w*l.source.h>16000000)throw Error('Kích thước lớp không hợp lệ');
    for(const [key,[min,max]] of Object.entries(numeric))if(!Number.isFinite(l[key])||l[key]<min||l[key]>max)throw Error('Giá trị không hợp lệ: '+key);
    if(typeof l.visible!=='boolean'||!/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(l.tint))throw Error('Màu / hiển thị không hợp lệ');
    if(typeof l.dataURL!=='string'||!l.dataURL.startsWith('data:image/png;base64,'))throw Error('Chỉ nhận PNG nhúng');
  }
  class Engine{
    constructor(){this.project=null;this.cache=new Map();}
    async load(project){
      if(!project||project.format!=='space-lab-pixel-layers'||project.version!==2||project.width!==1926||project.height!==816||!Array.isArray(project.layers)||project.layers.length>300)throw Error('Cần dự án Space Lab v2 · 1926×816');
      if(!project.sourceDataURL?.startsWith('data:image/png;base64,'))throw Error('JSON cần ảnh nguồn nhúng');
      const candidate=structuredClone(project),ids=new Set(),cache=new Map();
      for(const l of candidate.layers){validateLayer(l);if(ids.has(l.id))throw Error('ID lớp bị trùng');ids.add(l.id);}
      const reference=await image(candidate.sourceDataURL);
      if(reference.width!==candidate.width||reference.height!==candidate.height)throw Error('Sai kích thước ảnh nguồn');
      for(const l of candidate.layers){const img=await image(l.dataURL);if(img.width!==l.source.w||img.height!==l.source.h)throw Error('PNG khác metadata: '+l.id);const c=canvas(img.width,img.height);c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0);cache.set(l.id,{original:c});}
      this.project=candidate;this.cache=cache;this.reference=reference;return this;
    }
    layer(id){const l=this.project.layers.find(l=>l.id===id);if(!l)throw Error('Không có lớp: '+id);return l;}
    set(id,patch){const l=this.layer(id),allowed=new Set([...Object.keys(numeric),'name','visible','tint','group']);for(const k of Object.keys(patch))if(!allowed.has(k))throw Error('Không sửa trực tiếp '+k);const next={...l,...patch};validateLayer(next);Object.assign(l,next);return l;}
    setGroup(group,dx,dy){if(!Number.isFinite(dx)||!Number.isFinite(dy))throw Error('Delta không hợp lệ');const next=this.project.layers.filter(l=>l.group===group).map(l=>({...l,x:l.x+dx,y:l.y+dy}));next.forEach(validateLayer);next.forEach(n=>Object.assign(this.layer(n.id),n));}
    ordered(){return [...this.project.layers].sort((a,b)=>a.z-b.z);}
    sprite(l){
      const cache=this.cache.get(l.id),key=l.tint+':'+l.tintMix;if(!l.tintMix)return cache.original;if(cache.key===key)return cache.tinted;
      const w=l.source.w,h=l.source.h,c=canvas(w,h),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),pixels=cache.original.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,w,h),d=pixels.data;
      const rgb=[1,3,5].map(i=>parseInt(l.tint.slice(i,i+2),16));
      for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4)if(d[i+3])for(let k=0;k<3;k++)d[i+k]=Math.round(d[i+k]*(1-l.tintMix)+rgb[k]*l.tintMix);
      ctx.putImageData(pixels,0,0);cache.key=key;cache.tinted=c;return c;
    }
    render(ctx,{selection=null}={}){
      const {width,height}=this.project;ctx.save();ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
      for(const l of this.ordered()){if(!l.visible||!l.opacity)continue;ctx.save();ctx.translate(l.x,l.y);ctx.rotate(l.rotation*Math.PI/180);ctx.scale(l.scaleX,l.scaleY);ctx.globalAlpha=l.opacity;ctx.drawImage(this.sprite(l),0,0);ctx.restore();}
      if(selection){const l=this.layer(selection);ctx.save();ctx.translate(l.x,l.y);ctx.rotate(l.rotation*Math.PI/180);ctx.scale(l.scaleX,l.scaleY);ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.strokeStyle='#faf073';ctx.setLineDash([8,5]);ctx.strokeRect(0,0,l.source.w,l.source.h);ctx.restore();}ctx.restore();
    }
    local(l,x,y){const t=-l.rotation*Math.PI/180,dx=x-l.x,dy=y-l.y;return {x:(dx*Math.cos(t)-dy*Math.sin(t))/l.scaleX,y:(dx*Math.sin(t)+dy*Math.cos(t))/l.scaleY};}
    pick(x,y){for(const l of this.ordered().reverse()){if(!l.visible||!l.opacity)continue;const p=this.local(l,x,y),lx=Math.floor(p.x),ly=Math.floor(p.y);if(lx<0||ly<0||lx>=l.source.w||ly>=l.source.h)continue;if(this.cache.get(l.id).original.getContext('2d').getImageData(lx,ly,1,1).data[3])return {id:l.id,x:lx,y:ly};}return null;}
    checkPixel(l,x,y){if(!Number.isInteger(x)||!Number.isInteger(y)||x<0||y<0||x>=l.source.w||y>=l.source.h)throw Error('Pixel nằm ngoài lớp');}
    pixel(id,x,y){const l=this.layer(id);this.checkPixel(l,x,y);return [...this.cache.get(id).original.getContext('2d').getImageData(x,y,1,1).data];}
    paint(id,x,y,rgba){const l=this.layer(id);this.checkPixel(l,x,y);if(rgba.length!==4||!rgba.every(v=>Number.isInteger(v)&&v>=0&&v<=255))throw Error('RGBA phải là 4 số nguyên 0–255');const cache=this.cache.get(id),ctx=cache.original.getContext('2d'),d=new ImageData(1,1);d.data.set(rgba);ctx.putImageData(d,x,y);cache.key=null;l.dataURL=cache.original.toDataURL('image/png');}
    split(id,polygon,newId,name){
      const l=this.layer(id);
      if(l.x!==l.source.x||l.y!==l.source.y||l.rotation||l.scaleX!==1||l.scaleY!==1||l.tintMix||l.opacity!==1||!l.visible)throw Error('Đưa lớp về vị trí/màu gốc trước khi tách vùng nguồn');
      if(this.project.layers.some(v=>v.id===newId)||!newId)throw Error('ID mới bị trùng hoặc rỗng');
      if(polygon.length<3||!polygon.every(p=>p.length===2&&p.every(Number.isFinite)))throw Error('Cần đa giác ít nhất 3 điểm');
      const cache=this.cache.get(id),ctx=cache.original.getContext('2d'),src=ctx.getImageData(0,0,l.source.w,l.source.h),out=new ImageData(l.source.w,l.source.h);let count=0;
      for(let y=0;y<l.source.h;y++)for(let x=0;x<l.source.w;x++){const i=(y*l.source.w+x)*4;if(src.data[i+3]&&inPolygon(l.source.x+x+.5,l.source.y+y+.5,polygon)){out.data.set(src.data.subarray(i,i+4),i);src.data.fill(0,i,i+4);count++;}}
      if(!count)throw Error('Vùng chọn không chứa pixel của lớp này');
      const c=canvas(l.source.w,l.source.h);c.getContext('2d').putImageData(out,0,0);
      const child={...structuredClone(l),id:newId,name,group:l.group,dataURL:c.toDataURL('image/png'),z:Math.max(...this.project.layers.map(l=>l.z))+1,pixelCount:count,maskPolygon:polygon};
      validateLayer(child);ctx.putImageData(src,0,0);l.dataURL=cache.original.toDataURL('image/png');cache.key=null;this.project.layers.push(child);this.cache.set(newId,{original:c});return child;
    }
    verify(){const {width:w,height:h}=this.project,c=canvas(w,h);this.render(c.getContext('2d'));const actual=c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,w,h).data,r=canvas(w,h);r.getContext('2d').drawImage(this.reference,0,0);const ref=r.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,w,h).data;let differingPixels=0,maxChannelError=0;for(let i=0;i<actual.length;i+=4){let differs=false;for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const d=Math.abs(actual[i+k]-ref[i+k]);if(d)differs=true;maxChannelError=Math.max(maxChannelError,d);}if(differs)differingPixels++;}return {pixels:w*h,differingPixels,maxChannelError,layerCount:this.project.layers.length,exact:differingPixels===0};}
    exportProject(){return structuredClone(this.project);}
    exportPNG(){const c=canvas(this.project.width,this.project.height);this.render(c.getContext('2d'));return c.toDataURL('image/png');}
  }
  global.SpaceLab={Engine,inPolygon,toRepoPoint:(x,y)=>({x:x*1600/1926,y:y*678/816})};
})(window);

</script>
<script>
(async function(){
  'use strict';
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),scene=$('scene'),overlay=$('overlay'),ctx=scene.getContext('2d');
  const engine=new SpaceLab.Engine(),history=[];let selected=null,drag=null,polygon=[],dirty=false,busy=false;
  const fields=['name','x','y','scaleX','scaleY','rotation','z','opacity','tintMix','tint','visible'];
  function status(text,error=false){$('result').textContent=text;$('result').classList.toggle('error',error);}
  function checkpoint(){history.push(engine.exportProject());if(history.length>12)history.shift();$('undo').disabled=false;dirty=true;}
  function rows(){const q=$('search').value.toLocaleLowerCase();$('layer-list').replaceChildren();$('count').textContent=engine.project.layers.length;
    for(const l of engine.ordered().reverse())if((l.name+' '+l.id).toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q)){
      const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='layer-row';b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(l.id===selected));b.dataset.id=l.id;
      b.append(document.createTextNode((l.visible?'':'◌ ')+l.name));const small=document.createElement('small');small.textContent=l.id;b.append(small);b.onclick=()=>select(l.id);$('layer-list').append(b);
    }
  }
  function properties(){
    $('fields').querySelectorAll('input,button').forEach(el=>el.disabled=!selected);
    if(!selected){$('selection-id').textContent='Chọn một lớp để sửa';return;}
    const l=engine.layer(selected);$('selection-id').textContent=l.id;
    for(const key of fields){if(key==='visible')$(key).checked=l[key];else $(key).value=l[key];}
    $('bounds').textContent=`PNG ${l.source.w} × ${l.source.h} · gốc (${l.source.x}, ${l.source.y})`;
    $('group-label').textContent='Nhóm: '+l.group;
  }
  function drawOverlay(){
    const c=overlay.getContext('2d');c.clearRect(0,0,overlay.width,overlay.height);c.strokeStyle='#f3f387';c.fillStyle='#e7f77826';c.lineWidth=2;
    if(polygon.length){c.beginPath();polygon.forEach(([x,y],i)=>i?c.lineTo(x,y):c.moveTo(x,y));c.stroke();for(const [x,y] of polygon){c.fillStyle='#f3f387';c.fillRect(x-3,y-3,6,6);}}
    if(drag?.type==='rect'){const [x,y]=drag.start,[u,v]=drag.end;c.fillRect(Math.min(x,u),Math.min(y,v),Math.abs(u-x),Math.abs(v-y));c.strokeRect(Math.min(x,u),Math.min(y,v),Math.abs(u-x),Math.abs(v-y));}
  }
  function render(){engine.render(ctx,{selection:$('outlines').checked?selected:null});drawOverlay();}
  function select(id){selected=id;polygon=[];rows();properties();render();}
  function refresh(){rows();properties();render();}
  function point(e){const r=overlay.getBoundingClientRect();return [Math.floor((e.clientX-r.left)*overlay.width/r.width),Math.floor((e.clientY-r.top)*overlay.height/r.height)];}
  function fit(){const z=$('zoom').value,w=z==='fit'?Math.min($('viewport').clientWidth-2,engine.project.width):engine.project.width*Number(z);$('canvas-wrap').style.width=w+'px';$('canvas-wrap').style.height=(w*engine.project.height/engine.project.width)+'px';}
  function saveBlob(name,blob){const u=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),2000);}
  function saveURL(name,url){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=name;a.click();}
  function verify(){const r=engine.verify();status(r.exact?`Khớp ${r.pixels.toLocaleString('vi')} / ${r.pixels.toLocaleString('vi')} pixel · sai khác 0`:`${r.differingPixels.toLocaleString('vi')} pixel khác ảnh nguồn (bao gồm chỉnh sửa)`,!r.exact);return r;}
  function split(points){
    if(!selected)throw Error('Chọn lớp nguồn trước');
    const id='detail-'+Date.now().toString(36),snapshot=engine.exportProject();
    const child=engine.split(selected,points,id,'Chi tiết mới');history.push(snapshot);if(history.length>12)history.shift();$('undo').disabled=false;dirty=true;
    select(child.id);status('Đã tách '+child.pixelCount+' pixel thật. Đổi tên lớp ở bảng bên phải.');
  }
  function safe(fn){return function(...args){try{if(busy)return;return fn(...args);}catch(e){status(e.message,true);}};}
  for(const key of fields)$(key).addEventListener('change',safe(()=>{
    if(!selected)return;const value=key==='visible'?$(key).checked:['name','tint'].includes(key)?$(key).value:Number($(key).value);
    const before=engine.exportProject();engine.set(selected,{[key]:value});history.push(before);if(history.length>12)history.shift();$('undo').disabled=false;dirty=true;refresh();status('Đã chỉnh '+key+'. Lưu JSON để giữ thay đổi.');
  }));
  $('verify').onclick=safe(verify);$('search').oninput=safe(rows);$('zoom').onchange=safe(fit);$('outlines').onchange=safe(render);
  $('tool').onchange=()=>{polygon=[];drag=null;drawOverlay();};
  $('finish').onclick=safe(()=>{if(polygon.length<3)throw Error('Bấm ít nhất 3 đỉnh');const p=polygon;polygon=[];split(p);});
  $('reset-layer').onclick=safe(()=>{if(!selected)return;checkpoint();const l=engine.layer(selected);engine.set(selected,{x:l.source.x,y:l.source.y,scaleX:1,scaleY:1,rotation:0,opacity:1,tint:'#ffffff',tintMix:0,visible:true});refresh();status('Đã reset vị trí và màu pha; pixel đã vẽ giữ nguyên.');});
  $('move-group').onclick=safe(()=>{if(!selected)return;checkpoint();engine.setGroup(engine.layer(selected).group,Number($('group-x').value),Number($('group-y').value));refresh();status('Đã dịch nhóm; vị trí cũ để trong suốt.');});
  $('paint').onclick=safe(()=>{if(!selected)throw Error('Chọn lớp trước');const x=Number($('pixel-x').value),y=Number($('pixel-y').value),hex=$('pixel-color').value;const rgba=[1,3,5].map(i=>parseInt(hex.slice(i,i+2),16));rgba.push(Number($('pixel-alpha').value));checkpoint();engine.paint(selected,x,y,rgba);render();status(`Đã ghi pixel cục bộ (${x}, ${y}).`);});
  $('save').onclick=safe(()=>{saveBlob('space-lab-project.json',new Blob([JSON.stringify(engine.exportProject(),null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));dirty=false;status('Đã xuất JSON có đủ pixel và thông số.');});
  $('png').onclick=safe(()=>saveURL('space-lab-composite.png',engine.exportPNG()));
  $('layer-png').onclick=safe(()=>{if(selected)saveURL(selected+'.png',engine.sprite(engine.layer(selected)).toDataURL('image/png'));});
  $('open').onclick=()=>{if(!busy)$('file').click();};
  $('file').onchange=async()=>{const file=$('file').files[0];if(!file)return;busy=true;try{if(file.size>50000000)throw Error('JSON vượt 50 MB');const parsed=JSON.parse(await file.text()),before=engine.exportProject();await engine.load(parsed);history.push(before);if(history.length>12)history.shift();$('undo').disabled=false;dirty=false;select(engine.project.layers[0].id);verify();}catch(e){status('Không mở được: '+e.message,true);}finally{busy=false;$('file').value='';}};
  $('undo').onclick=async()=>{if(busy||!history.length)return;busy=true;try{await engine.load(history.pop());if(!engine.project.layers.some(l=>l.id===selected))selected=engine.project.layers[0].id;dirty=true;refresh();$('undo').disabled=!history.length;status('Đã hoàn tác.');}catch(e){status(e.message,true);}finally{busy=false;}};
  overlay.addEventListener('pointerdown',safe(e=>{
    const p=point(e),tool=$('tool').value;overlay.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    if(tool==='polygon'){if(!selected)throw Error('Chọn lớp nguồn ở danh sách');polygon.push(p);drawOverlay();return;}
    if(tool==='rect'){if(!selected)throw Error('Chọn lớp nguồn ở danh sách');drag={type:'rect',start:p,end:p};return;}
    const hit=engine.pick(...p);if(!hit)return;select(hit.id);
    if(tool==='pixel'){
      $('pixel-x').value=hit.x;$('pixel-y').value=hit.y;const color=engine.pixel(hit.id,hit.x,hit.y);
      $('pixel-color').value='#'+color.slice(0,3).map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');$('pixel-alpha').value=color[3];status(`Pixel (${p[0]}, ${p[1]}) · RGBA ${color.join(', ')}`);return;
    }
    const l=engine.layer(hit.id);drag={type:'move',start:p,x:l.x,y:l.y,saved:false};
  }));
  overlay.addEventListener('pointermove',safe(e=>{
    const p=point(e),repo=SpaceLab.toRepoPoint(...p);$('coordinates').textContent=`Nguồn ${p[0]}, ${p[1]} px · Repo ${repo.x.toFixed(2)}, ${repo.y.toFixed(2)}`;
    if(!drag)return;if(drag.type==='rect'){drag.end=p;drawOverlay();return;}
    if(!drag.saved&&(p[0]!==drag.start[0]||p[1]!==drag.start[1])){checkpoint();drag.saved=true;}
    engine.set(selected,{x:drag.x+p[0]-drag.start[0],y:drag.y+p[1]-drag.start[1]});properties();render();
  }));
  overlay.addEventListener('pointerup',safe(()=>{const d=drag;drag=null;if(d?.type==='rect'){
    const [x,y]=d.start,[u,v]=d.end;if(x===u||y===v){drawOverlay();return;}split([[Math.min(x,u),Math.min(y,v)],[Math.max(x,u),Math.min(y,v)],[Math.max(x,u),Math.max(y,v)],[Math.min(x,u),Math.max(y,v)]]);
  }else if(d?.saved)status('Đã di chuyển pixel của lớp; ô caro là nền chưa biết.');drawOverlay();}));
  overlay.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{drag=null;drawOverlay();});
  window.addEventListener('keydown',safe(e=>{
    if(/INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA/.test(document.activeElement.tagName))return;
    if(e.key==='Escape'){polygon=[];drag=null;drawOverlay();return;}
    const dirs={ArrowLeft:[-1,0],ArrowRight:[1,0],ArrowUp:[0,-1],ArrowDown:[0,1]};
    if(selected&&dirs[e.key]){e.preventDefault();checkpoint();const l=engine.layer(selected),d=dirs[e.key],n=e.shiftKey?10:1;engine.set(selected,{x:l.x+d[0]*n,y:l.y+d[1]*n});properties();render();}
  }));
  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(engine.project)fit();});window.addEventListener('beforeunload',e=>{if(dirty){e.preventDefault();e.returnValue='';}});
  try{
    await engine.load(window.SPACE_LAB_PROJECT);window.lab=engine;
    window.editor={render,select,verify,refresh,undo:()=>$('undo').click(),ready:true};
    selected='alec-column-center';refresh();fit();verify();
  }catch(e){status('Không tải được: '+e.message,true);console.error(e);}
})();

</script></body></html>
